title: All-h source-root-conditioned unilateral Fréchet lower is identically zero
statement: For each h>=1, s=2^h, each pair of separately typed COMPLETE globally injected original W(3,s) physical pair-label maps f,g, and each TRUE original point p, define U_p as genuine six-DISTINCT-original-incidence sets with source point profile B=(2,1,1,1,1) repeated exactly at p and source line profile A=(1^6). Let L_p(f)=U_p intersect the original point-side physical B-projection and R_p(g)=U_p intersect the original line-side physical A-projection. With d=s+1, V=(s+1)(s^2+1), a minimal binom(a,2)>=V, source universe lower M_p=binom(d,2)*prod_{j=0}^3[d(V-3-2j)]/24, left B cap B_p=3*binom(a-2,4)*binom(d,2)*d^4 and right A cap A=70*binom(a,6)*d^6, one has |U_p|>=M_p>B_p+A>=|L_p|+|R_p|. Therefore the Fréchet marginal-only lower max(0,|L_p|+|R_p|-|U_p|) is EXACTLY ZERO, for every p,f,g. The dual original line-root A/B statement holds. This is a limitation of marginals, not a zero real intersection.

quantifiers.domain: arbitrary separately typed COMPLETE globally injected original point/line physical-pair mappings shared across all actual original six-incidence sets
any genuine ORIGINAL source point root of W(3,s), with dual source-line-root result by true GQ point-line duality

external_dependencies: Genuine W(3,s) source incidence graph and point-line duality; original six distinct incidence-ID constraint.
Exact source combinatorial counting from AA4-S pinned document, cases s=2,4,8,16 exact and analytic s>=32.
Fréchet lower formula is sharp only in the relaxed arbitrary-subsets-with-prescribed-marginals model, not necessarily among globally injective physical maps.
limitations: This theorem does NOT assert that the genuine globally coherent B/A intersection L_p(f) intersect R_p(g) vanishes.
Zero Fréchet floor does NOT imply the universal seven-class lower conjecture is false or any global low-S counterfamily.
Adding original incidence position correlations or full two-sided joint constraints may overcome this marginal-only obstruction.
falsification_boundary: A valid counterexample must be in the same actual root-conditioned ORIGINAL six-incidence U_p, at minimal physical alphabet and legal global maps; numerical failure must concern the claimed marginal bound M_p>B_p+A, not a separate joint correlation.
